units.name: UpdatePlayerOscillatingMotion
units.summary: Protected state bit 7 redirects to knockback. Otherwise advance a 24-step phase at C660 and add the selected signed word from CPU 2566 to primary Y. units.name: ApplyLatchedPlayerDirections
units.summary: Push CPU 2546 as the continuation and rotate the latched direction bits through carry. Each selected direction updates its axis through the common motion service; diagonal movement uses magnitude 00B5 instead of 0100. The pushed continuation is FinishLatchedPlayerDirections.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeLeft
units.summary: Preserve the remaining direction bits in AF, choose X velocity FF00 or FF4B for diagonal input, set facing bits 0/5 and update horizontal motion before restoring AF.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeDown
units.summary: Preserve AF, choose downward Y velocity 0100 or 00B5, clear acceleration and set vertical direction bit 6 before the common vertical update.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeUp
units.summary: Preserve AF and test the upper screen threshold at Y=30. At or above the threshold select Y velocity FF00 or FF4B and clear vertical direction bit 6. Below the threshold the branch joins the velocity store with the preselected positive magnitude, preserving the encoded boundary behavior.

regions.summary: Service the collision/lifetime guard and object motion, then dispatch movement, airborne and turn-delay substates. Screen-extension bounds choose a turn when leaving the visible interval. Tile probes choose walking speed +/-00C0 and animations 5F/61, a facing reversal with animation 5E/60, or an upward hop with acceleration 40. Airborne contact enters an eight-tick stationary delay before returning to walking.

units.name: UpdatePatrollingActorWithTurnDelay
units.summary: Service the collision/lifetime guard and object motion, then dispatch movement, airborne and turn-delay substates. Screen-extension bounds choose a turn when leaving the visible interval. Tile probes choose walking speed +/-00C0 and animations 5F/61, a facing reversal with animation 5E/60, or an upward hop with acceleration 40. units.name: UpdateTrackingThrowActor
units.summary: After the shared guards, face the primary actor when separated by at least eight pixels and select the idle animation sequence. A successful free-slot allocation creates type 28, clears animation timing and enters the throw sequence. Wait for its animation index to return to zero, then use a 64-tick cooldown while continuing to face the primary actor.

units.name: UpdateFacingGuardThrowActor
units.summary: Use the same type-28 throw and 64-tick cooldown sequence, but preserve the established facing. Outside the eight-pixel near interval, only throw when the primary actor lies on the permitted facing side; the opposite side returns without spawning.

units.name: UpdateTurningGuardThrowActor
units.summary: Use the shared guarded throw/cooldown behavior. When the primary actor is outside the eight-pixel near interval on the wrong side, switch to type 1D/1E according to the stored facing instead of throwing. This separates the turn behavior from the type-28 projectile allocation.

units.name: SelectGuardTurnType
units.summary: Choose object type 1D or 1E from motion flag bit 5 and clear the substate, allowing the selected turn handler to reinitialize it.

units.name: FinishActorRenderInitialization
units.summary: Clear render flag bit 0 and return; the entry-specific type/category/animation fields are already installed.

units.name: UpdateLinkedMovingActor
units.summary: While scrolling is active, run the alternate collision guard; a hit can change type 62 to 29. Initialize category 14, animation 68 and horizontal speed +/-0300. The stage-progress bits determine whether to enter the outward/return phase or ordinary movement. The outward phase accumulates distance, reverses velocity and flags at its bound or tile contact, then counts back down; completion sets state bit 3 in the linked parent object through fields 30/31. Terminal contact requests sound B7 and joins object removal.

units.name: UpdateProximityHoppingActor
units.summary: Initialize category 8, animation 6D and zero velocities. A primary actor within 32 pixels arms vertical acceleration. Later substates choose horizontal velocity +/-0280 from facing and obstruction, perform the common vertical update, wait 16 ticks on contact and hop again with Y velocity FC00. Extended X or the primary actor relation selects facing animations 6E/6F; the mechanics do not establish the character identity.

units.name: UpdateScreenEdgeJumpingActor
units.summary: Initialize category 7 and facing animation 69. Approach/height tests arm a jump with acceleration 28 and upward velocity FA80 or FE00. Airborne movement uses a small +/-0040 X velocity until contact; landing chooses an eight- or 60-tick state based on Y=B8. Another state integrates Y directly, clamps at E0 and returns to the timed animation state. Sound AD accompanies the encoded jump/landing conditions.

units.name: UpdateApproachAndThrowActor
units.summary: Push the shared motion helper as the return continuation. Initialize category 0A, animation 75, acceleration 40 and facing flags 21; the initialization discards that pushed helper return. Subsequent substates approach the primary actor at +/-0080, handle tile-triggered jumps, accumulate a bounded travel phase and allocate type-31 projectiles. Throw and recovery use separate fields 41/40 timers before returning to approach. Allocation failure also enters recovery, so no nonexistent child slot is used.

units.name: UpdateLeftSideStationaryThrowActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0A and animation 74 once, discarding the pushed motion helper during setup. Only consider throwing when the actor is in the main X page and the primary actor is to its left. Count down 16 ticks initially, allocate a type-31 child if a slot is free and reload 80 ticks regardless of allocation success.

units.name: UpdateRightSideStationaryThrowActor
units.summary: Mirror the stationary throw condition: initialize animation 77 and flags zero, then require the primary actor on the right side. Use the same 16-tick initial and 80-tick repeat delays with guarded type-31 child allocation.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingStandoffThrowActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0A, animation 75 and acceleration 40. Approach at +/-0080 until the primary actor lies in the encoded 64..71-pixel standoff band, then stop and prepare animation 76 for 16 ticks. Allocate type 32, wait 60 ticks after success or 120 after failure, and recover through animation 74. Tile contact diverts through the common jump/landing state with an eight-tick recovery. Initialization discards the pushed motion helper; later returns execute it.

units.name: UpdateRightFacingStandoffThrowActor
units.summary: Mirror the standoff behavior using animations 78/79/77 and opposite facing. Maintain the 64..71-pixel band, prepare a type-32 throw for 16 ticks and use separate success/failure cooldowns. Tile contact uses the same vertical recovery path; all child writes follow successful allocation.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActorCategorySix
units.summary: Choose category 6 and join the shared type-35 initialization.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActorCategorySeventeen
units.summary: Choose category 17 before the shared type-35 setup.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActor
units.summary: Set type 35, animation 62, acceleration 40, facing flags 21 and a zero phase selector, then clear render flag 0. The two preceding entries select its category.

units.name: UpdateLinkedThrowAndPatrolActor
units.summary: Run shared guards and dispatch five substates. A nearby primary actor on the left allows allocation of type 29; save the parent IX pointer into the child fields 30/31 and copy the event index with high bits C0. Wait for the linked child to set parent state bit 3, pause 30 ticks, then select one of four four-byte travel/velocity records using field 41. units.name: UpdateLeapingApproachActor
units.summary: Cull and move relative to the camera, then guard the leading screen edge. Substates handle initial landing, approach, close attack and an eight-tick recovery. Approach at +/-0180 toward the primary actor; within 32 pixels stop and run facing animation 8A/8D. Leading tile classes choose small FE80 or large F940 upward hops, update the motion bits and return to landing. Attack completion restores idle animation 88/8B. A boundary entry reverses the chosen velocity/facing. The bank-crossing conditional jump is retained as exact raw bytes with its mnemonic comment.

units.name: ActivateHopActorNearPrimary

units.name: InitializeVerticalProximityHopActor

units.name: UpdateVerticalProximityHopActor
units.summary: Wait until the primary actor is within 48 screen pixels, then start a one-tick delay. Expiry selects animation 85/87, Y velocity FC00 and airborne substate two. Use the common vertical/contact update until landing, restore the encoded idle animation and wait 30 ticks before repeating. No horizontal velocity is installed by this handler.

units.name: InitializeFacingThrowActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flag pair 7B/21 or 7E/00 from the incoming zero flag. Set category 0B, acceleration 30 and type 4F.

units.name: UpdateFacingThrowActor
units.summary: Face the primary actor and try allocating a type-58 child unless motion bit 4 blocks the action. Successful allocation selects throw animation 7D/80 and resets animation timing. Wait for animation index zero, then restore idle animation and use a 30-tick cooldown. Alternate tile-class paths stop X motion and start FE80 or FA00 vertical recovery before the same cooldown.

units.name: InitializeThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0B/type 52 with the facing-dependent idle animation, acceleration 30 and a zero throw counter in field 41.

units.name: UpdateThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Perform three guarded type-58 throws, with animation completion and 30-tick cooldown after each. Then clear a travel phase and rush toward the primary actor at +/-0110. Tile contact can switch to vertical recovery; otherwise accumulate 0110 until the high byte reaches 18, stop and reset the throw counter. Recovery chooses a blocked-zero or facing-signed X velocity while airborne, then returns to the cooldown. Motion bit 4 diverts through the tile-class response.

units.name: InitializeContinuousChaseActor
units.summary: Choose the idle animation/facing pair, category 0B, acceleration 30 and type 55.

units.name: UpdateContinuousChaseActor
units.summary: Continuously face and approach the primary actor at +/-0110, halving the signed speed when within 32 pixels. Contact or a leading obstruction enters vertical recovery, with an upward FB70 hop for the obstruction path. Airborne motion chooses X speed only when unblocked. Landing stops X motion for eight ticks before resuming pursuit.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingStationaryThrower
units.summary: Initialize category 0B, acceleration 30, left-facing flags and animation 7B once. Only throw while the primary actor is to the left and motion bit 4 is clear. Successful allocation installs type 58, selects animation 7D and resets timing. Animation completion starts a 30-tick cooldown, then returns to the idle throw check.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Initialize the same left-facing thrower with a zero throw counter. After three type-58 throws and their 30-tick cooldowns, begin a leftward FEF0 rush with a zero travel phase. Contact or obstruction switches to recovery; otherwise accumulate 0110 until high byte 18, stop, clear the throw counter and cool down. Recovery uses X velocity FEF0 when clear, but the blocked branch deliberately writes 0010 rather than zero; preserve that encoded small positive drift.

units.name: InitializeDistanceScaledHopActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flags 4E/21 or 4F/00, set category 11, type 65 and acceleration 30.

units.name: InitializeDistanceScaledHopAirborne
units.summary: Enter the same actor family already airborne: animation 4D, flags C0, category 11, type 65, acceleration 30, render flag 0 and substate one.

units.name: UpdateDistanceScaledHopActor
units.summary: Cull and move with the camera. Initial state computes horizontal speed from the primary-X distance, starts Y velocity FA00 and marks airborne motion. During flight change animation to 4D once vertical direction bit 6 is set. Landing faces the primary actor, stops X motion and waits 16 ticks before repeating.

units.name: ComputeHopVelocityFromPrimaryDistance
units.summary: Take absolute primary-X separation, divide the distance shifted by eight by 130 using the shared restoring divider, restore the horizontal sign and double the result into object X velocity. This scales the horizontal component to the encoded hop timing; no independent natural-range claim is needed.

units.name: InitializeTurningPatrolHopActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flags 8E/21 or 90/00, set category 0F, type 69 and acceleration 40.

units.name: UpdateTurningPatrolHopActor
units.summary: Walk in the stored facing direction, turning near screen edges 18/E8 and pausing eight ticks. The leftward walking speed is FEE0 and the rightward speed 0120. Tile classes select upward hops of FE80 or FA00; other obstruction can trigger FB00. Airborne motion preserves the encoded asymmetry: left FEE0 versus right 0078 when unblocked. Landing waits eight ticks before returning to patrol.

units.name: UpdateCapturableActorProgress
units.summary: Initialize category 18/animation 43 and apply tile response until object state bit 7 marks capture. Then set stage-progress bit 6 at the low-six-bit event index, switch to type 5A/substate zero and request sound 9D. Uncaptured later calls use the shared cull/camera-motion path. The character identity is uncertain; the capture/progress mechanics are explicit.

units.name: FlyCapturedActorToHud
units.summary: Initialize animation 44 and a velocity aimed toward screen target Y=08,X=E4 with scale 0400. Integrate both 8.8 coordinates until Y<10 and X lies in DC..EB. Then use the low event-index nibble to read stage progress, publish its low nibble with high bit set at C653 and remove the actor. That request is consumed by the timed HUD/reward service below.
