units.summary: Store HL as the object's 8.8 horizontal velocity. Clear motion bits 0 and 5, merge the caller's E direction bits, then tail-call the common horizontal update.

units.name: FinishPlayerDirectionChange
units.summary: Complete the caller's horizontal-velocity write, clear motion direction bits 0/5 and merge D. Select sequence CPU 1F90 and continue through the common horizontal motion helper. The low velocity byte is prepared by the preceding classified fragment.

units.name: PlayerActionSharedTail
units.summary: Join the existing player-action continuation at CPU 1F2F without changing state.

units.name: RestartPlayerRecoverySequence
units.summary: Clear the object animation timer/index and restart sequence CPU 1F90. The following entries implement player airborne/recovery and timed-action transitions using the shared player epilogue.

units.name: BeginGlobalEffectVariantOne
units.summary: Set global flags 81 and a 0708 timer, restore primary object type one and mark state bit 2 on each nonzero saved actor slot. Eleven 48-byte saved slots are traversed before returning through the shared restoration continuation.

units.name: UpdatePlayerAscendingState
units.summary: Push the common player epilogue and service the vertical helper. While the upper scroll boundary is open, forward Y velocity to the scroll delta. At the boundary, seed acceleration 30 and choose upward speed FA00 or FC00 from screen Y, then enter substate one.

units.name: SnapPlayerToCeilingTiles
units.summary: A tile sample with masked flags 60 snaps screen Y to an eight-pixel boundary and joins the existing contact continuation. With neither sample matching, keep the ordinary airborne update.

units.name: UpdatePlayerAirborneRecovery
units.summary: Run the collision guard and vertical helper, then dispatch recovery substates. Motion flag bit 6 can begin downward velocity 0400 with acceleration cleared. Later entries distinguish tile flag 40, screen scrolling and local Y integration.

units.name: UpdatePlayerFallingContact
units.summary: Test both sampled tiles for masked flag 40. Contact selects substate two and snaps Y to eight pixels. Otherwise either add the 8.8 Y velocity to local Y or copy it to the vertical scroll delta, according to boundary and motion flags.

units.name: FinishPlayerLandingScroll
units.summary: While the lower scroll boundary is open, optionally subtract eight pixels from screen Y and forward velocity to scrolling. At the boundary, set the landing scroll flags, clear the Y fraction/substate, restore primary type one and clear object state bit 7 before the shared landing helper.

units.name: UpdateTimedPlayerSpecialAction
units.summary: A countdown in field 40 controls the action. While active, a new controller bit-4 press with bit 5 held can restart the preceding action branch. Expiry restores object type one; substate one instead enters the global-effect service below.

units.name: BeginGlobalPlayerEffect
units.summary: Request sound B4, initialize global-effect flags/timers, save 11 actor slots to scratch and clear the active actor area. Save the 32-byte palette, enter substate one and push the existing banked continuation. The action selector at C07E chooses one of three graphics sources for selectors 3,4,6; other values leave the graphics upload unarmed.

units.name: ArmGlobalEffectGraphics
units.summary: Save HL as the graphics source and set global-effect bit 6. The source is later consumed with bank 4 mapped; this is a CPU pointer with an explicit bank contract.

units.name: ServiceGlobalPlayerEffect
units.summary: Upload the armed bank-4 graphics to VRAM 06C0 once, clear its request bit, and wait for remaining global flags to clear. Then dispatch the saved action selector through CPU 2175; nominal index zero aliases the preceding JP operand bytes and remains Code.

units.name: BeginGlobalEffectVariantTwo
units.summary: Set global flags 82 and the 0708 timer, restore primary type one/substate zero, then join the saved-actor restoration continuation.

units.name: BeginFourWayGlobalEffect
units.summary: Set global flags 83 and a 180-tick timer, enter primary type 0D and create four type-17 actors near the primary position. Their signed X/Y velocities form four diagonal directions. Field 40 is initialized to eight and sound 96 is requested.

units.name: BeginPairedGlobalEffect
units.summary: Set global flags 84 and a 180-tick timer, enter primary type 0F and place two type-10 actors at vertical offsets -120 and -40. Preserve the extended Y sign for underflow and choose animations 45/46 before requesting sound 96.

units.name: BeginGlobalEffectVariantFive
units.summary: Set global flags 85 with the 0708 timer and primary type 0C/substate zero, then restore the saved actor area through the shared continuation.

units.name: BeginFiveProjectileGlobalEffect
units.summary: Set global flags 86 and a 180-tick timer, enter primary type 0E and initialize a type-10 actor plus five type-18 actors. Fixed Y placements and staggered X positions spread the projectiles; each of the five receives X velocity FC00 and Y velocity 0040. Request sound 96. The game presentation name of this effect remains uncertain.

units.name: RestoreActorsAfterGlobalEffectSetup
units.summary: Copy the saved 528-byte actor area from scratch back to C310, restoring eleven 48-byte actor slots.

units.name: UpdatePlayerStageExitMotion
units.summary: Push the common player epilogue and initialize substate one once. Stage behavior bit 0 chooses a facing-dependent stationary animation; otherwise choose animation 04 and X velocity 0100. Run the motion helper until extended/screen X crosses the encoded threshold, then set the stage-clear session bit.

units.name: UpdatePlayerRecoveryTimer
units.summary: Run the collision guard, horizontal update and contact helper. When motion bit 7 clears, normalize facing flags, enter substate one and load an eight-tick timer. Expiry restores type one or type 0B from the HUD action flag; global-effect bit 3 can select type 0C. Clear object state bit 7 on return to ordinary activity.

units.name: ResetPlayerSubstateWithCarry
units.summary: Clear the object substate and return carry set, allowing the caller to reject its normal continuation.

units.name: UpdatePlayerDeathSequence
units.summary: Push the common player epilogue and run two timed substates. First choose facing-dependent animation 0F/1F for 16 ticks and request sound 95; then use animation 10/20 for 60 ticks. Expiry sets session bit 0 to request the life-loss transition.

units.name: WaitForGlobalEffectActors
units.summary: When global-effect bit 7 is clear, scan fourteen actor slots for nonzero types and wait until all are empty, then join the common global-effect completion. While bit 7 remains set, the following timer periodically creates actors.

units.name: ClearPlayerProtectionOnZero
units.summary: Only a zero result from the preceding timer path clears object state bit 6. Preserve the state on nonzero return.

units.name: HideObjectFromStageFlag
units.summary: If the caller-selected flag byte has bit 0 set, set render flag bit 7 to suppress object output; otherwise return unchanged.

units.name: ResetObjectSubstate
units.summary: Clear the current 48-byte object substate and return.

units.name: HoldPrimaryAnimationFrame
units.summary: Set the animation frame timer to 7F, then join the shared animation-frame continuation.

units.name: JoinPlayerTileResponse
units.summary: Join the adjacent shared tile-response block while preserving the caller-prepared state.

units.name: PlayerMotionReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the player motion service.

units.name: AcceleratePlayerVerticalAndSampleTiles
units.summary: Clear both primary tile samples and add the unsigned acceleration byte to the 8.8 Y velocity. An overflow marks vertical direction bit 6. Once that bit is set, probe the two vertical contact samples at offsets -4 and +3 and save their tile flags.

units.name: TestPlayerTileContactClasses
units.summary: Two entries classify the paired tile samples. The first returns carry for a nonzero masked class other than 40; the second does the same for a class other than 60. Both return clear carry when both samples are zero or match the allowed class. The mask is 60; other tile bits do not affect these tests.

units.name: SelectPlayerHitboxSequenceVariant
units.summary: Read the established primary hitbox variant and join the shared sequence selector. This byte is a variant index, not a ROM bank.

units.name: UpdatePatrollingActorWithTurnDelay
units.summary: Service the collision/lifetime guard and object motion, then dispatch movement, airborne and turn-delay substates. Screen-extension bounds choose a turn when leaving the visible interval. Tile probes choose walking speed +/-00C0 and animations 5F/61, a facing reversal with animation 5E/60, or an upward hop with acceleration 40. Airborne contact enters an eight-tick stationary delay before returning to walking.

units.name: InitializeActorType1A_CategoryThreeLeft
units.summary: Initialize category 3, left-facing flags 21, animation 5C and type 1A, then join the shared render-flag reset. The following adjacent entries supply the alternate type/category/facing combinations.

units.name: UpdateTrackingThrowActor
units.summary: After the shared guards, face the primary actor when separated by at least eight pixels and select the idle animation sequence. A successful free-slot allocation creates type 28, clears animation timing and enters the throw sequence. Wait for its animation index to return to zero, then use a 64-tick cooldown while continuing to face the primary actor.

units.name: UpdateFacingGuardThrowActor
units.summary: Use the same type-28 throw and 64-tick cooldown sequence, but preserve the established facing. Outside the eight-pixel near interval, only throw when the primary actor lies on the permitted facing side; the opposite side returns without spawning.

units.name: UpdateTurningGuardThrowActor
units.summary: Use the shared guarded throw/cooldown behavior. When the primary actor is outside the eight-pixel near interval on the wrong side, switch to type 1D/1E according to the stored facing instead of throwing. This separates the turn behavior from the type-28 projectile allocation.

units.name: SelectGuardTurnType
units.summary: Choose object type 1D or 1E from motion flag bit 5 and clear the substate, allowing the selected turn handler to reinitialize it.

units.name: InitializeActorType1A_CategoryThreeRight
units.summary: Initialize type 1A/category 3 with right-facing flags zero and animation 5A.

units.name: InitializeActorType1A_CategoryTwoLeft
units.summary: Initialize type 1A/category 2 with flags 21 and animation 58.

units.name: InitializeActorType1A_CategoryTwoRight
units.summary: Initialize type 1A/category 2 with flags zero and animation 56.

units.name: InitializeActorType1C_Left
units.summary: Initialize type 1C/category 1 with flags 21 and animation 54.

units.name: InitializeActorType1C_Right
units.summary: Initialize type 1C/category 1 with flags zero and animation 52.

units.name: InitializeActorType1B_CategoryOneLeft
units.summary: Initialize type 1B/category 1 with flags 21 and animation 54.

units.name: InitializeActorType1B_CategoryOneRight
units.summary: Initialize type 1B/category 1 with flags zero and animation 52.

units.name: InitializeActorType1B_CategoryThreeLeft
units.summary: Initialize type 1B/category 3 with flags 21 and animation 5C.

units.name: InitializeActorType1B_CategoryThreeRight
units.summary: Initialize type 1B/category 3 with flags zero and animation 5A.

units.name: InitializeActorType1B_CategoryTwoRight
units.summary: Initialize type 1B/category 2 with flags zero and animation 56, falling through to the render-flag reset.

units.name: FinishActorRenderInitialization
units.summary: Clear render flag bit 0 and return; the entry-specific type/category/animation fields are already installed.

units.name: UpdateLinkedMovingActor
units.summary: While scrolling is active, run the alternate collision guard; a hit can change type 62 to 29. Initialize category 14, animation 68 and horizontal speed +/-0300. The stage-progress bits determine whether to enter the outward/return phase or ordinary movement. The outward phase accumulates distance, reverses velocity and flags at its bound or tile contact, then counts back down; completion sets state bit 3 in the linked parent object through fields 30/31. Terminal contact requests sound B7 and joins object removal.

units.name: UpdateProximityHoppingActor
units.summary: Initialize category 8, animation 6D and zero velocities. A primary actor within 32 pixels arms vertical acceleration. Later substates choose horizontal velocity +/-0280 from facing and obstruction, perform the common vertical update, wait 16 ticks on contact and hop again with Y velocity FC00. Extended X or the primary actor relation selects facing animations 6E/6F; the mechanics do not establish the character identity.

units.name: UpdateScreenEdgeJumpingActor
units.summary: Initialize category 7 and facing animation 69. Approach/height tests arm a jump with acceleration 28 and upward velocity FA80 or FE00. Airborne movement uses a small +/-0040 X velocity until contact; landing chooses an eight- or 60-tick state based on Y=B8. Another state integrates Y directly, clamps at E0 and returns to the timed animation state. Sound AD accompanies the encoded jump/landing conditions.

units.name: UpdateApproachAndThrowActor
units.summary: Push the shared motion helper as the return continuation. Initialize category 0A, animation 75, acceleration 40 and facing flags 21; the initialization discards that pushed helper return. Subsequent substates approach the primary actor at +/-0080, handle tile-triggered jumps, accumulate a bounded travel phase and allocate type-31 projectiles. Throw and recovery use separate fields 41/40 timers before returning to approach. Allocation failure also enters recovery, so no nonexistent child slot is used.

units.name: UpdateLeftSideStationaryThrowActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0A and animation 74 once, discarding the pushed motion helper during setup. Only consider throwing when the actor is in the main X page and the primary actor is to its left. Count down 16 ticks initially, allocate a type-31 child if a slot is free and reload 80 ticks regardless of allocation success.

units.name: UpdateRightSideStationaryThrowActor
units.summary: Mirror the stationary throw condition: initialize animation 77 and flags zero, then require the primary actor on the right side. Use the same 16-tick initial and 80-tick repeat delays with guarded type-31 child allocation.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingStandoffThrowActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0A, animation 75 and acceleration 40. Approach at +/-0080 until the primary actor lies in the encoded 64..71-pixel standoff band, then stop and prepare animation 76 for 16 ticks. Allocate type 32, wait 60 ticks after success or 120 after failure, and recover through animation 74. Tile contact diverts through the common jump/landing state with an eight-tick recovery. Initialization discards the pushed motion helper; later returns execute it.

units.name: UpdateRightFacingStandoffThrowActor
units.summary: Mirror the standoff behavior using animations 78/79/77 and opposite facing. Maintain the 64..71-pixel band, prepare a type-32 throw for 16 ticks and use separate success/failure cooldowns. Tile contact uses the same vertical recovery path; all child writes follow successful allocation.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActorCategorySix
units.summary: Choose category 6 and join the shared type-35 initialization.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActorCategorySeventeen
units.summary: Choose category 17 before the shared type-35 setup.

units.name: InitializeLinkedThrowActor
units.summary: Set type 35, animation 62, acceleration 40, facing flags 21 and a zero phase selector, then clear render flag 0. The two preceding entries select its category.

units.name: UpdateLinkedThrowAndPatrolActor
units.summary: Run shared guards and dispatch five substates. A nearby primary actor on the left allows allocation of type 29; save the parent IX pointer into the child fields 30/31 and copy the event index with high bits C0. Wait for the linked child to set parent state bit 3, pause 30 ticks, then select one of four four-byte travel/velocity records using field 41. Patrol reverses at tile obstructions, subtracts 0080 from its phase accumulator and pauses another 30 ticks before restarting. On the other side, a short walking branch uses tile samples and the shared obstacle probe. The exact character/action presentation remains tentative.

units.name: UpdatePlayerOscillatingMotion
units.summary: Protected state bit 7 redirects to knockback. Otherwise advance a 24-step phase at C660 and add the selected signed word from CPU 2566 to primary Y. Probe contact and snap Y when appropriate, then latch controller input or enter the new-action path. The table gives a bounded oscillating vertical displacement, not an inferred physical acceleration law.

units.name: StopPlayerFreeMotion
units.summary: Clear both primary velocities, then join the latched-direction handler.

units.name: ApplyLatchedPlayerDirections
units.summary: Push CPU 2546 as the continuation and rotate the latched direction bits through carry. Each selected direction updates its axis through the common motion service; diagonal movement uses magnitude 00B5 instead of 0100. The pushed continuation is FinishLatchedPlayerDirections.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeLeft
units.summary: Preserve the remaining direction bits in AF, choose X velocity FF00 or FF4B for diagonal input, set facing bits 0/5 and update horizontal motion before restoring AF.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeDown
units.summary: Preserve AF, choose downward Y velocity 0100 or 00B5, clear acceleration and set vertical direction bit 6 before the common vertical update.

units.name: MovePlayerFreeUp
units.summary: Preserve AF and test the upper screen threshold at Y=30. At or above the threshold select Y velocity FF00 or FF4B and clear vertical direction bit 6. Below the threshold the branch joins the velocity store with the preselected positive magnitude, preserving the encoded boundary behavior.

units.name: SpawnGlobalEffectDiagonalActor
units.summary: Every 16 ticks scan five slots from C3D0 for a free actor. Create type 17 at the primary position with independently selected X/Y velocities +0600 or FA00; refresh-register bits select the signs. A full slot set returns without spawning.

units.name: WaitForGlobalEffectStateFlag
units.summary: Wait for global-effect bit 7 to clear, then set object state bit 6 and enter substate one. Subsequent calls join the common completion service.

units.name: ClearActorsAfterGlobalEffect
units.summary: Once global-effect bit 7 clears, enter substate one and zero the 672-byte actor area from C280. Later calls use the shared completion entry.

units.name: RestoreProgressAfterGlobalEffect
units.summary: Inspect the two saved objects at D610/D640. For a nonzero saved object, use its field 32 as a stage-progress index and set progress bit 7 while clearing bit 5. Refresh stage state inside an interrupt guard, then restore primary type one/substate zero.

units.name: TestPlayerTileContactClass60
units.summary: The alternate entry accepts masked tile class 60 rather than 40, using the same carry convention.

units.name: AnimationPointersVariantZero
units.summary: Animation variant zero: little-endian CPU pointers. Its first zero cell is not an animation body.

units.name: AnimationPointersVariantOne
units.summary: Animation variant one. Both variants share the finite animation bodies below; natural coverage of every selector is not established.

units.name: AnimationFrameLists
units.summary: Animation bodies occupy this packed interval: static bodies contain a zero marker and one frame-ID byte; animated bodies have a three-byte header followed by the encoded count of frame-ID bytes.

units.name: SpriteFramePointersVariantZero
units.summary: 199 little-endian CPU pointers to counted sprite frames.

units.name: SpriteFramePointersVariantOne
units.summary: 235 little-endian CPU pointers to counted sprite frames. Both variants use the frame bodies below.

units.name: CountedSpriteFrameBodies
units.summary: Each frame is count, presentation byte, then count three-byte parts: Y offset, X offset and pattern offset. The renderer uses the presentation byte for collision-record selection. All 434 pointed records fit this envelope.

units.name: SpriteFrameContainerTail
units.summary: 55 FF bytes between the final counted frame and the renderer at CPU $AD00. No record schema or runtime consumer is established for this tail.

units.name: BonusCountedWaves
units.summary: Packed wave bodies: two header bytes followed by the counted sequence selectors. All selectors fit the 47-cell sequence table.

units.name: BonusVelocityWords
units.summary: Velocity words begin at CPU $BC88. Index zero deliberately shares the last two bytes of the final wave; preserve the overlapping storage identity.

units.name: BonusSequencePointers
units.summary: 47 little-endian CPU pointers selected by object field 38.

units.name: BonusActorSequences
units.summary: Each actor sequence has count plus three setup bytes, followed by count three-byte commands. Command actions are $71..$79; sequence interpretation belongs to the bonus actor handler.

units.name: BonusSequenceTail
units.summary: 39 FF bytes after the final sequence through the bank boundary. Their precise use is unknown.

units.name: StageSectionEventPointers
units.summary: 33 little-endian CPU pointers to the six-byte event streams below. Adjacent encoded origins independently bound each stream.

units.name: StageSixByteEvents
units.summary: 598 six-byte records across the pointed streams, ending at CPU $B3DC. Preserve the full six-byte terminal record; do not treat an interior zero type as end-of-stream.

units.name: MusicTempoTable
units.summary: Fifteen tempo bytes, indexed by the music request selector.

units.name: MusicHeaderPointers
units.summary: 15 little-endian music header pointers.

units.name: EffectHeaderPointers
units.summary: 35 little-endian effect header pointers.

units.name: SpecialSoundHeaderPointer
units.summary: One special header pointer.

units.name: AlternateMusicHeaderPointers
units.summary: 15 alternate music header pointers.

units.name: AlternateEffectHeaderPointers
units.summary: 35 alternate effect header pointers.

units.name: AlternateSpecialSoundHeaderPointer
units.summary: One alternate special header pointer.

units.name: SpecialSoundRequestHandlers
units.summary: Four stored request-handler words for B4..B7. The accepted B8 request reads the following opcode bytes at CPU $8381 as $033A; that alias remains Code, not a fifth stored pointer.

units.name: FmPitchWords
units.summary: 74 little-endian pitch words; the next stream origin independently bounds this container.

units.name: CountedSoundHeadersAndStreams
units.summary: Packed sound headers and command streams. Each header is one channel-count byte followed by count nine-byte channel descriptors copied into 32-byte RAM records. The finite parse covers 86 headers and 5704 stream bytes. Duration reuse, raw pitch, slides and command jump/call/return/loops are reader-dependent: the fourth PSG music and seventh FM music slots use the noise/drum reader; register E0 alone does not select it for shared effects.

units.name: AttenuationEnvelopePointersAndRecords
units.summary: Thirteen little-endian attenuation-envelope pointers, followed by their packed marker records. Control markers 80..83 are interpreted by the envelope consumer; the next independent base bounds the container.

units.name: PitchEnvelopePointersAndRecords
units.summary: Seven little-endian pitch-envelope pointers and their marker records, bounded by the sample-player code at CPU $AC4B. Exact natural selector coverage remains unknown.

units.name: StageScrollHeaderRecords
units.summary: Twelve-byte source stride with 16-byte LDIR windows. Map bank and CPU base together identify each matrix; metatiles use eight bytes per entry.

units.name: InitializeMirroredLinkedThrowActor
units.summary: Choose category 6 or alternate category 17, then initialize type 38, animation 65, acceleration 40, right-facing flags zero and phase selector zero. Clear render flag 0; the following update mirrors the linked throw/patrol actor.

units.name: JoinObjectHorizontalIntegration
units.summary: Join the existing horizontal position integration with the caller-prepared coordinate and velocity.

units.name: PropagateObjectYExtension
units.summary: Use the signed velocity high byte and carry from the low-word addition to update ObjectYExtended. Positive motion increments the extension only on carry; negative motion decrements it only without carry.

units.name: ReportLeadingTileClassOne
units.summary: Return tile-probe class one to the caller. The byte is a result code, not an object type.

units.name: ReportLeadingTileClassTwo
units.summary: Return tile-probe class two to the caller.

units.name: SnapObjectYAndClearContact
units.summary: Snap screen Y down to an eight-pixel boundary and clear motion/contact bit 7 before returning.

units.name: ReleaseObjectProgressReservation
units.summary: Split field 32 into a low-six-bit index and high-two-bit reservation kind. Kinds 40/80 clear stage-progress bits 4/5 respectively; kind zero clears bit 7 in D000-indexed storage, while C0 skips those writes. Set carry and join the shared object-removal continuation.

units.name: ApplyInverseCameraDeltaWithCarry
units.summary: Negate ActualHorizontalCameraDelta, apply it through the object coordinate helper and return carry set. This provides the camera-relative fallback for the surrounding cull/motion service.

units.name: AllocateActorChildSlot
units.summary: Scan four 48-byte slots beginning at C460 for a zero type. Failure returns clear carry and A=0. Success leaves IY at the free slot, copies the parent motion bits masked by 23, sets render flag 0 and positions it using category/facing-selected signed Y/X offsets from CPU 3A88. Propagate coordinate carries into extended bytes, clear both fractions and return carry set. The caller must assign the child type after success; no type is installed here.

units.name: SelectObjectAnimationByCategoryAndFacing
units.summary: Index a caller-supplied byte-pair table by category times two. Facing bit 5 chooses the first or second byte, which becomes the animation ID.

units.name: StartObjectVerticalHop
units.summary: Stop horizontal motion, set upward velocity FB00 and tail-call the tile-flag response helper.

units.name: ClearObjectTravelPhaseRight
units.summary: Clear the two-byte travel phase in fields 28/29 before continuing to the right-motion setup.

units.name: SetObjectRightwardSpeed0180
units.summary: Clear direction bits 0/5 and set X velocity 0180 (1.5 pixels/frame in 8.8 units).

units.name: SetAlternateObjectRightwardSpeed0180
units.summary: The alternate entry installs the same right-facing flags and X velocity 0180 for its caller-specific preceding setup.

units.name: ClearObjectTravelPhaseLeft
units.summary: Clear fields 28/29 before the leftward-motion setup.

units.name: SetObjectLeftwardSpeed0180
units.summary: Set direction bits 0/5 and X velocity FE80 (-1.5 pixels/frame in 8.8 units).

units.name: UpdateObjectHopOrTravelPhase
units.summary: Active contact bit 7 enters airborne substate three with Y velocity zero and direction bit 6 set. Otherwise an obstruction stops X motion and chooses an upward FB00 hop or a 30-tick wait from the primary-actor relation/facing. With no obstruction, add 0180 to fields 28/29 until the high byte reaches 20, then fall through to the shared stop/wait setup.

units.name: EnterObjectFifteenTickWait
units.summary: Complete the preceding velocity-high-byte store, load field 40 with 15 ticks and select substate two.

units.name: FinishObjectWaitAndFacePrimary
units.summary: Only continue when the previous timer result is zero. Clear substate and horizontal velocity; compare primary X with object X to choose animation 73/71 and direction bits zero/21.

units.name: EnterAlternateObjectFifteenTickWait
units.summary: Complete the caller-prepared velocity store and enter substate two with a 15-tick timer. The following entries initialize and update the next actor type.

units.name: InitializeMirroredLinkedThrowCategorySeventeen
units.summary: Select category 17 before the shared type-38 setup.

units.name: UpdateMirroredLinkedThrowAndPatrolActor
units.summary: Run the shared guards, face the primary actor on the right and allocate linked type-29 children within 160 pixels. Store the parent pointer and encoded progress index in the child. A parent-state acknowledgement starts a 30-tick pause, followed by one of four phase/velocity records at CPU 3799. Patrol reverses at obstruction and subtracts 0080 from the phase before another 30-tick pause. The opposite-side near branch walks left only when tile samples permit it; this mirrors the earlier type-35 handler.

units.name: ClassifyPairedTileContacts
units.summary: Combine the two saved tile samples after masking each by 60. Matching/absent class-40 or class-60 samples produce result one or two; incompatible or unsupported combinations return zero. These small result codes drive the adjacent actor jump responses.

units.name: ComputeObjectVelocityFromTargetDeltas
units.summary: Compute absolute Y/X separation from target E/D and save direction bits. Use the restoring division helper to scale the component ratio, then write a negative vertical component and a horizontal component signed by the target-X relation. The saved vertical-side flag is not used in the final stores, so this is not a general four-quadrant aiming contract. No coincident-target or zero-divisor guard is present in this fragment.

units.name: InitializeCloseRangeActorLeft
units.summary: Use flags 21 and animation 92, then join category-10/type-3C initialization with acceleration 30 and render flag 0 cleared.

units.name: InitializeCloseRangeActorRight
units.summary: Use flags zero and animation 95 before the shared type-3C setup.

units.name: UpdateCloseRangeHopActor
units.summary: Run shared guards and dispatch five substates. Face the primary actor, approach at +/-0140 outside the near interval, attack inside 24 pixels, and hop in the encoded 64..67-pixel band. Tile contact or obstruction enters airborne movement; landing uses a 30-tick wait. Attack animation completion reverses motion bit 0 and starts an FB00 hop. The special range hop uses +/-0100 X velocity and an eight-tick landing wait before rejoining approach. Boundary entries restore the appropriate facing and animation.

units.name: InitializePatrolActorLeft
units.summary: Prepare animation 60, flags 21 and velocity FF40; the adjacent right entry supplies animation 5E, flags zero and velocity 00C0. Both become type 19/category 5 and clear render flag 0.

units.name: InitializePatrolActorRight
units.summary: Prepare the right-facing patrol animation and +00C0 velocity before the shared type-19 setup.

units.name: InitializeObjectAlternateAnimation72
units.summary: Supply animation 72 and zero motion flags as the alternate entry to the adjacent object initialization.

units.name: InitializeLeapingApproachActor
units.summary: The incoming zero flag chooses animation/flag pair 88/E3 or 8B/C2. Set category 0E, acceleration 40 and type 43, then clear render flag 0. The flag-dependent entry contract is inherited from the caller, not recomputed here.

units.name: UpdateLeapingApproachActor
units.summary: Cull and move relative to the camera, then guard the leading screen edge. Substates handle initial landing, approach, close attack and an eight-tick recovery. Approach at +/-0180 toward the primary actor; within 32 pixels stop and run facing animation 8A/8D. Leading tile classes choose small FE80 or large F940 upward hops, update the motion bits and return to landing. Attack completion restores idle animation 88/8B. A boundary entry reverses the chosen velocity/facing. The bank-crossing conditional jump is retained as exact raw bytes with its mnemonic comment.

units.name: InitializePeriodicHopActor
units.summary: Choose flag-dependent animation 84/86 and flags E1/C0, set category 0D, acceleration 40, type 46 and an eight-tick initial delay; clear render flag 0.

units.name: UpdatePeriodicHopActor
units.summary: After the countdown, select hop animation 85/87, upward velocity FC00 and active airborne flags. During flight choose X velocity +/-0180 unless a leading tile blocks it. Landing restores idle animation 84/86, stops X motion and loads a 30-tick delay before the next hop.

units.name: InitializeDormantHopActor
units.summary: Initialize the same category/animation family as the periodic hopper but use type 49 and preseed Y velocity FC00. Render flag 0 is cleared.

units.name: ActivateHopActorNearPrimary
units.summary: After the shared cull/motion helpers, compare absolute screen-X distance with 48 pixels. Inside that interval change type to 46, load a one-tick delay and select its airborne substate; otherwise leave it dormant.

units.name: InitializeVerticalProximityHopActor
units.summary: Choose idle animation 84/86 and flags E1/C0, set category 0D, acceleration 40 and type 4C, then clear render flag 0.

units.name: UpdateVerticalProximityHopActor
units.summary: Wait until the primary actor is within 48 screen pixels, then start a one-tick delay. Expiry selects animation 85/87, Y velocity FC00 and airborne substate two. Use the common vertical/contact update until landing, restore the encoded idle animation and wait 30 ticks before repeating. No horizontal velocity is installed by this handler.

units.name: InitializeFacingThrowActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flag pair 7B/21 or 7E/00 from the incoming zero flag. Set category 0B, acceleration 30 and type 4F.

units.name: UpdateFacingThrowActor
units.summary: Face the primary actor and try allocating a type-58 child unless motion bit 4 blocks the action. Successful allocation selects throw animation 7D/80 and resets animation timing. Wait for animation index zero, then restore idle animation and use a 30-tick cooldown. Alternate tile-class paths stop X motion and start FE80 or FA00 vertical recovery before the same cooldown.

units.name: InitializeThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Initialize category 0B/type 52 with the facing-dependent idle animation, acceleration 30 and a zero throw counter in field 41.

units.name: UpdateThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Perform three guarded type-58 throws, with animation completion and 30-tick cooldown after each. Then clear a travel phase and rush toward the primary actor at +/-0110. Tile contact can switch to vertical recovery; otherwise accumulate 0110 until the high byte reaches 18, stop and reset the throw counter. Recovery chooses a blocked-zero or facing-signed X velocity while airborne, then returns to the cooldown. Motion bit 4 diverts through the tile-class response.

units.name: InitializeContinuousChaseActor
units.summary: Choose the idle animation/facing pair, category 0B, acceleration 30 and type 55.

units.name: UpdateContinuousChaseActor
units.summary: Continuously face and approach the primary actor at +/-0110, halving the signed speed when within 32 pixels. Contact or a leading obstruction enters vertical recovery, with an upward FB70 hop for the obstruction path. Airborne motion chooses X speed only when unblocked. Landing stops X motion for eight ticks before resuming pursuit.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingStationaryThrower
units.summary: Initialize category 0B, acceleration 30, left-facing flags and animation 7B once. Only throw while the primary actor is to the left and motion bit 4 is clear. Successful allocation installs type 58, selects animation 7D and resets timing. Animation completion starts a 30-tick cooldown, then returns to the idle throw check.

units.name: UpdateLeftFacingThreeThrowRushActor
units.summary: Initialize the same left-facing thrower with a zero throw counter. After three type-58 throws and their 30-tick cooldowns, begin a leftward FEF0 rush with a zero travel phase. Contact or obstruction switches to recovery; otherwise accumulate 0110 until high byte 18, stop, clear the throw counter and cool down. Recovery uses X velocity FEF0 when clear, but the blocked branch deliberately writes 0010 rather than zero; preserve that encoded small positive drift.

units.name: UpdateHorizontalTileProjectile
units.summary: Move relative to the camera and remove on a nonzero X extension. Once screen X is at least eight, sample the current tile and use its E0/80 class with motion bit 1 to detect blocking contact. Contact nudges X by four pixels according to direction, changes type to 16 and clears the substate.

units.name: EnterProjectileImpactType
units.summary: Clear substate, change object type to 16 and return.

units.name: FinishArcProjectileTileTest
units.summary: For the alternate tile class, preserve the projectile while motion bit 1 is set; otherwise tail-call removal. The intervening byte remains Unknown.

units.name: UpdateSlowHorizontalProjectile
units.summary: Initialize category 15, animation 81 and facing X speed +/-0140, then request sound B2. Continue camera-relative movement until page escape or a direction-sensitive blocking tile.

units.name: JoinObjectFacingInitialization
units.summary: Join the adjacent common facing/animation initialization with the caller-prepared flags.

units.name: ObjectInitializationReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the object initialization flow.

units.name: InitializeBouncingProjectile
units.summary: Set acceleration 30, clear the wait/bounce counters and load a lifetime of A0 in field 28. Action kind one chooses type 15 with Y velocity FF00; other actions choose type 14 and FE00. Set the active airborne flag.

units.name: UpdateSingleBounceProjectile
units.summary: Move relative to the camera and apply vertical/contact motion. State bit 6, loss of airborne contact, or a blocking tile joins the type-16 impact transition. Horizontal page culling remains active; tile class and motion bit 1 retain their encoded directional test.

units.name: UpdateRepeatedBounceProjectile
units.summary: Count down the A0 lifetime and test state bit 6 before vertical/contact movement. Landing stops X motion and waits eight ticks. Then clamp the bounce counter to index two, select one of three six-byte velocity profiles at CPU 494C, choose the facing X word, restart airborne motion and increment the counter. Blocking leading tiles or lifetime expiry enter the shared impact transition. The finite profiles are PlayerBounceVelocityProfiles.

units.name: UpdateProjectileImpactAnimation
units.summary: Move with the camera. Initialize animation 3F with timing and horizontal velocity cleared, then wait for animation index zero before removal. Preserve the encoded sound quirk: candidate A8/AB is loaded into C but overwritten by LD C,A; SoundRequest receives the original field-32 value, not either candidate.

units.name: UpdateFastHorizontalProjectile
units.summary: Initialize category 4 and facing animation 50/51 with X velocity -0240/+0240, then request sound 97. Subsequent calls move relative to the camera and remove on page escape or the direction-sensitive blocking tile condition.

units.name: UpdateStraightType7AProjectile
units.summary: Initialize category 16, animation 7A and facing X velocity +/-01C0; request sound 98. Continue camera-relative movement until leaving the page or hitting the encoded blocking tile class.

units.name: InitializeAimedArcProjectile
units.summary: Initialize category 16 and animation 7A, nudge X by two according to facing and choose an X velocity word from CPU 4AEA/4AF0 according to primary Y versus object Y+28. Set upward Y velocity FD00, acceleration 20 and the airborne flag, then request sound 98.

units.name: UpdateAimedArcProjectile
units.summary: Move horizontally and vertically, then remove on X-page escape, completed airborne motion, screen Y at least D0, or the direction-sensitive blocking tile test. The last alternate tile branch continues in the separately classified fragment below.

units.name: UpdateDescendingActorToY90
units.summary: Move without acceleration and cull on X-page escape. Initialize category 1C, animation 55, X velocity FE00 and downward Y velocity 0200 with counters cleared. At Y>=90 stop Y motion and enter substate two; that substate keeps the established constant horizontal motion.

units.name: UpdateDescendingActorToYA8
units.summary: The alternate descending entry uses Y velocity 0300 and stops vertical motion at Y>=A8. It shares category 1C, animation 55, X velocity FE00, page culling and the terminal substate behavior.

units.name: ProjectileReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return preceding the projectile handlers.

units.name: UpdateFastLeftwardProjectile
units.summary: Run the alternate collision guard, then constant-velocity motion. Initialize animation 98, category 12, flags 21 and X velocity FB00, set render flag 0 and request sound AE. Cull once extended X is FF and screen X has passed below F0. The collision-carry path joins removal directly.

units.name: UpdateSingleVerticalReflectionProjectile
units.summary: After the collision guard and constant-velocity move, wait for a leading-tile obstruction. Negate Y velocity exactly once, enter substate one and request sound AE. Afterwards remove when the extended-X/screen-distance test leaves the near-axis range.

units.name: UpdateSingleFullReflectionProjectile
units.summary: As in the preceding reflection handler, but negate both Y and X velocities on the first leading-tile obstruction. Substate one prevents repeated reflection and uses the same page-distance removal test.

units.name: InitializeDiagonalProjectileType5C_Left
units.summary: Select X velocity FD40; the adjacent entry selects 02C0. Both initialize downward Y velocity 03C0, category 12, animation 98, flags 21 and type 5C with render flag 0 set.

units.name: InitializeDiagonalProjectileType5C_Right
units.summary: Select X velocity 02C0 before the shared type-5C projectile setup.

units.name: InitializeDiagonalProjectileType5D_Left
units.summary: Select X velocity FD40 for the otherwise matching category-12 projectile of type 5D.

units.name: InitializeDiagonalProjectileType5D_Right
units.summary: Select X velocity 02C0 before the shared type-5D projectile setup.

units.name: InitializeDistanceScaledHopActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flags 4E/21 or 4F/00, set category 11, type 65 and acceleration 30.

units.name: InitializeDistanceScaledHopAirborne
units.summary: Enter the same actor family already airborne: animation 4D, flags C0, category 11, type 65, acceleration 30, render flag 0 and substate one.

units.name: UpdateDistanceScaledHopActor
units.summary: Cull and move with the camera. Initial state computes horizontal speed from the primary-X distance, starts Y velocity FA00 and marks airborne motion. During flight change animation to 4D once vertical direction bit 6 is set. Landing faces the primary actor, stops X motion and waits 16 ticks before repeating.

units.name: ComputeHopVelocityFromPrimaryDistance
units.summary: Take absolute primary-X separation, divide the distance shifted by eight by 130 using the shared restoring divider, restore the horizontal sign and double the result into object X velocity. This scales the horizontal component to the encoded hop timing; no independent natural-range claim is needed.

units.name: InitializeTurningPatrolHopActor
units.summary: Choose animation/flags 8E/21 or 90/00, set category 0F, type 69 and acceleration 40.

units.name: UpdateTurningPatrolHopActor
units.summary: Walk in the stored facing direction, turning near screen edges 18/E8 and pausing eight ticks. The leftward walking speed is FEE0 and the rightward speed 0120. Tile classes select upward hops of FE80 or FA00; other obstruction can trigger FB00. Airborne motion preserves the encoded asymmetry: left FEE0 versus right 0078 when unblocked. Landing waits eight ticks before returning to patrol.

units.name: UpdateCapturableActorProgress
units.summary: Initialize category 18/animation 43 and apply tile response until object state bit 7 marks capture. Then set stage-progress bit 6 at the low-six-bit event index, switch to type 5A/substate zero and request sound 9D. Uncaptured later calls use the shared cull/camera-motion path. The character identity is uncertain; the capture/progress mechanics are explicit.

units.name: FlyCapturedActorToHud
units.summary: Initialize animation 44 and a velocity aimed toward screen target Y=08,X=E4 with scale 0400. Integrate both 8.8 coordinates until Y<10 and X lies in DC..EB. Then use the low event-index nibble to read stage progress, publish its low nibble with high bit set at C653 and remove the actor. That request is consumed by the timed HUD/reward service below.

units.name: DrawTimedRewardPanel
units.summary: Map bank 9, load a 48-tick panel timer and use the caller byte low nibble to select a graphics source word at CPU 511C. Upload 0140 bytes to VRAM 2660, then draw the two-row/five-column panel rectangle at 3834 from CPU 512E. Bank and CPU source must be interpreted together.

units.name: ApplyTimedCaptureReward
units.summary: Only act when the preceding timer result is zero. Dirty the four-cell HUD, restore the panel rectangle and consume/clear C653. Its low nibble selects the encoded reward branch: type 7 refills the HUD meter and plays 9B; types 4/5/6 set hitbox variant 1/2/3; type 3 increments projectile variant below five, reads its slot-count table and plays 9A. Types 1/2 and the default use the separately explained banked/session continuations; do not infer additional reward names from the selector alone.

units.name: SetBonusSessionRewardFlag
units.summary: Set session bit 7 and return. This flag is consumed by the existing bonus-shooting transition, not evidence of an ending route.

units.name: AdvanceGlobalEffectPaletteFlash
units.summary: Continue only on a negative timer result, reload one tick and increment the palette phase while it is below six. Intermediate phases fill all 32 palette bytes from CPU 51B5; phase five restores the saved D500 palette. Upload all 32 colors through the shared palette service. Later completed phases use the existing terminal continuation.

units.name: PaletteEffectReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return after the timed palette-effect service.

units.name: UpdateGlobalEffectBouncingActor
units.summary: Move without acceleration while the global effect remains active. Probe tiles 12 pixels along each axis and compare the screen limits to decide when to reflect Y or X velocity. Reflection negates the selected word, then adds the refresh register to its low byte without propagating an extra carry into the stored high byte; preserve that encoded variation. Motion low-nibble bits select the animation from CPU 5297. Once the global effect ends, remove actors with a nonzero coordinate extension and leave on-page ones intact.

units.name: UpdateAcceleratingEffectActor
units.summary: Use animation 48 and constant-velocity integration, then add 0020 to horizontal velocity each frame. Remove at X extension two. Once primary X is not left of the actor, stop vertical velocity. The following entries implement independent flicker/removal and hit-recovery behaviors.

units.name: ToggleHudIndicatorTilePairs
units.summary: On the negative timer result, reload 16 ticks and complement the phase byte. Select tile 1 for nonzero phase or tile 9 for zero, then write two cells at each VRAM address 3824 and 3864. VDP reads and paired EX(SP),HL operations provide the encoded bus timing; they do not consume inline parameters.

units.name: RefillHudMeterReward
units.summary: Request sound 9B, copy the HUD meter limit to its current value and transfer to bank-2 CPU B314 with A=0.

units.name: SetHitboxVariantThreeReward
units.summary: Select hitbox variant three and join the shared variant store.

units.name: SetHitboxVariantTwoReward
units.summary: Select hitbox variant two and join the shared variant store.

units.name: SetHitboxVariantOneReward
units.summary: Select hitbox variant one; the shared store writes PlayerHitboxVariant and returns.

units.name: IncreaseProjectileVariantReward
units.summary: Increment ProjectileVariant only while the result is below five, update ProjectileSlotCount from CPU 510E and request sound 9A. Saturated variants return without changing the slot count or requesting that sound.

units.name: ApplyBankedRewardOne
units.summary: Transfer to the current window-2 CPU B28B entry with A=1. The reward handler caller must supply its bank-2 execution context.

units.name: UpdateObjectThirtyTwoTickFlicker
units.summary: Set the animation timer to one and alternate render suppression using field 26 parity. At count 32 remove the object; otherwise stop X motion, cull by the shared range rules and move with the camera.

units.name: UpdateObjectHitRecoveryLanding
units.summary: Choose X velocity +/-0100 from state bit 5 only while the actor is away from the screen axis and no leading tile blocks it. Move with the camera and apply vertical/contact motion. On landing stop X motion, clear protected state bit 7, restore the saved object type from field 27 and clear the substate.

units.name: RecheckStageEventCursorBackward
units.summary: Start the shared event check from StageEventCursor minus eight bytes. Preserve that exact cursor-relative adjustment; it is not a new event-record stride claim.

units.name: FindStageActorSlotGroupOne
units.summary: Preserve the active register set with EXX and scan three 48-byte slots after the primary object. A zero type enters the existing allocation success path. If all are busy, restore registers and clear reservation bit 4 in the caller-selected progress byte.

units.name: FindStageActorSlotGroupTwo
units.summary: Scan two 48-byte slots after C3D0 with the alternate register set. On exhaustion restore registers and clear progress reservation bit 5; a free slot joins the shared allocation entry.

units.name: StageEventReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return from the event service.

units.name: RecheckAlternateEventCursorForward
units.summary: Start the alternate event scanner from StageEventCursor plus four bytes, preserving its existing cursor convention.

units.name: RecheckAlternateEventCursorBackward
units.summary: Re-enter the alternate event scanner with cursor minus eight bytes; this offset does not redefine the six-byte event data format.

units.name: FindAlternateStageActorSlotGroupOne
units.summary: Scan the same three slots after the primary object for the alternate event path. A free slot joins its allocation continuation; exhaustion restores registers and clears progress reservation bit 4.

units.name: FindAlternateStageActorSlotGroupTwo
units.summary: Scan two slots after C3D0 for the alternate event path, clearing reservation bit 5 only if both are occupied.

units.name: AlternateStageEventReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return from the alternate event service.

units.name: InitializeBonusDoorScene
units.summary: Disable interrupts, clear sprite/game work RAM, copy the bonus camera setup and preserve the 128-byte name-table source at C880. Rebuild the display with bank-12 and bank-9 RLE graphics, select the alternate animation/frame tables and queue the bonus palette. Set camera X to 6000 and initialize the door animation delay. This is the first-person shooting bonus scene established by the saved artificial gameplay visit.

units.name: TransferBonusDoorStrips
units.summary: Presentation bit 6 selects the six-by-six overlay continuation. Otherwise copy two bytes for each strip element from four saved RAM/VRAM pairs, stepping diagonally by +62,-66,+66,-62 bytes. Each pair uses the encoded strip count in C621. Keep RAM and VRAM coordinates separate even where their low offsets match.

units.name: DrawBonusShootingOverlay
units.summary: Map bank 12 and select one of two B717/B73B tile sources from the caller flag bit 0. Draw a six-row, six-column rectangle at VRAM 3CA0; every source tile byte is followed by fixed attribute 11.

units.name: LoadBonusCommandHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Map bank 3 and form the BC88 velocity-table offset from the command family and current wave index. Read the signed X velocity word, then restore bank 2. Index-zero storage deliberately overlaps the final wave bytes; no independent full selector domain is inferred.

units.name: UpdateBonusTimedJumpStates
units.summary: A hit in the initial wait selects type 7B. Otherwise wait 32 ticks, start Y velocity FA00 and advance through the jump integration. Increase acceleration by 20 each tick, add it to Y velocity and integrate Y with the encoded additional 0180 displacement. Crossing Y=6000 starts a 24-tick landing wait; a hit there selects the alternate hit animation, while expiry returns type 70 for the next command.

units.name: UpdateBonusEscapeTargetStates
units.summary: A hit during the delay selects type 7B. On delay expiry select animation 98 and upward velocity FA00. Integrate Y until its unsigned addition no longer carries, then set the shared bonus failure flag. This escape condition ends the bonus loop; the variable is not a palette-transition request in this context.

units.name: RecordBonusTargetHit
units.summary: On first hit enter FF substate, stop both velocities, wait 16 ticks, decrement the remaining target count and increment the hit tally. Request sound 99 and invoke the bank-2 award helper with A=2. Sequence selector 46 additionally sets C678. Subsequent calls remove the actor when the wait expires; failure removes it immediately.

units.name: AdvanceBonusDoorOpening
units.summary: Wait for frames and count down the four-tick step timer after the initial 16-tick delay. Stop once the door phase reaches 27. Each phase computes four VRAM/RAM source pairs and a strip length from CPU 5A69, increments the phase, then requests the frame-service presentation transfer. This four-sided source/destination motion opens the door; it is not normal stage scrolling.

units.name: ServiceBonusAimAndFireInput
units.summary: Use the shot cooldown to arm presentation requests and require a fresh action-button press before allocating a shot. Ignore firing while the bonus failure flag is set. Left/right input shifts the 24-bit camera X by +/-0200 and clamps its integer portion to 0..00B8, accumulating the actual delta at C639. The source preserves separate screen/camera fixed-point identities.

units.name: ServiceBonusWaveSpawning
units.summary: Initialize each wave once by mapping bank 3 and resolving BB3E plus twice the incremented wave index. Copy its spawn count and delay, save the stream cursor and request sound 82. Thereafter count the delay, scan eight 48-byte target slots for a free type and spawn type 70 with sequence selector in field 38. Exhausting spawn count starts a 256-tick wait, then a 128-tick sound-B5 ending delay; remaining hit count chooses success/failure bits before setting the wave-complete bit. No natural maximum wave index is established by this handler alone.

units.name: AllocateBonusShotActor
units.summary: Ignore failure state and gate this allocation with C675 bit 7. Scan four 48-byte slots from C460, create type 7A in the first free slot, position its X from the camera plus 20 pixels and request sound 91. A full group returns without a shot; the surrounding bonus services own gate reset.

units.name: ReadBonusActorSequenceCommand
units.summary: Abort/remove on the bonus failure flag. For a fresh type-70 actor, map bank 3 and read its selected BD2A descriptor: command count, X extension/fraction/integer setup and command cursor. Decrement the remaining command count with underflow removal, then read the next three-byte type/operand command into fields 0/36/37. Restore bank 2 before returning; command handlers own the substate initialization.

units.name: SelectBonusCommandAnimation
units.summary: Mask object type to seven bits, subtract 71 and select the command-family animation byte from CPU 5CED. This selects presentation without changing the three-byte command cursor.

units.name: InitializeBonusHorizontalTargetAtY30
units.summary: On first entry initialize Y=30, its extension/fraction zero and substate one. Load the family/wave X velocity and command animation before joining the shared endpoint/collision service.

units.name: UpdateBonusHorizontalTargetAtY60
units.summary: Initialize the alternate target at Y=60. A hit flag selects the hit animation and type 7B. Otherwise cull X-page escape and compare the current 8.8 X with the command endpoint using the velocity sign. Reaching the endpoint changes back to type 70 for the next sequence command; other calls move horizontally with the camera.

units.name: InitializeBonusTimedJumpTarget
units.summary: Initialize command animation, substate one and a 32-tick wait. Dispatch later substates through CPU 5DC0; nominal index zero aliases the preceding JP operand bytes and remains Code.

units.name: InitializeBonusEscapeTarget
units.summary: Initialize a 24-tick delay and the command animation. Later substates dispatch through CPU 5E81, whose index-zero word is the preserved preceding JP-operand alias.

units.name: UpdateBonusRisingAnimatedTarget
units.summary: Initialize Y=A0, upward velocity FA00, animation 9D and a three-tick animation divider. A hit removes this actor directly. Otherwise alternate animation parity every three ticks; height bands 90/80/70/60/50 choose the pair from CPU 5F60. Integrate Y and remove below the encoded 2000 threshold.

units.name: InitializeBonusFallingThreat
units.summary: Unless the wave is complete, initialize once with animation A9 at Y=20,X=80 and downward velocity 0A00, mark the bonus threat flag and request sound A6. Later substates dispatch through CPU 5FFB, preserving its index-zero JP-operand alias.

units.name: UpdateBonusThreatLandingAndTimeout
units.summary: Integrate the threat Y position until it reaches C000 in 8.8 units; C000 here is a coordinate threshold, not the SessionFlags RAM address. Stop Y motion and enter substate two with a 300-tick field-33/34 timer. Expiry sets wave-complete bit 0, maps audio bank 6 to mute sound, then restores bank 2.

units.name: InitializeBonusExitGraphicCopy
units.summary: Initialize the reused C670 word as VRAM offset zero and C672 as source CPU AF54. These are exit-copy cursors in this phase; C670 was the spawn-delay byte during gameplay.

units.name: AdvanceBonusExitGraphicCopy
units.summary: Finish the current VRAM transfer, restore bank 2 and advance both exit-copy cursors by 0100. Until source reaches BE54 return with phase unchanged; then select exit phase two. Source and VRAM cursor are different address spaces.

units.name: FinishBonusExitPaletteRequest
units.summary: Request a palette upload, set exit phase three and install type 7C in the first actor slot. This C66D value is an exit phase, preserving its earlier nonzero-abort meaning for bonus target handlers.

units.name: DispatchEncounterProjectileCycle
units.summary: Move without acceleration and dispatch the encounter substate through the finite CPU 64DD word table.

units.name: DispatchSegmentedDirectionActor
units.summary: Update the moving actor and its coordinate trail first, then dispatch its substate through CPU 674D. The actor owns two companion type-86 slots selected by field 40.

units.name: DispatchSegmentCompanion
units.summary: Move without acceleration and dispatch through the two-entry CPU 67AD table. Companion field 40 selects its parent trail buffer.

units.name: ShowBonusResultsAndAwards
units.summary: Clear palette/display state under an interrupt guard and expand the bank-2 results graphics. Wave-result bits choose the failure message, target-hit scoring display or successful reward path. For hits, convert the tally and five-times-hit award to decimal tiles while issuing the encoded banked award calls. The success path awards five units, chooses the wave-indexed reward graphic and repeats that award when the special target was hit. Fade in, wait up to 256 frames or a fresh action press, fade out and restore VDP register zero. This reports bonus results, not ending credits.

units.name: DrawBonusDecimalDigit
units.summary: Double digit A to index the two-byte tile word at CPU 637E, then tail-call the VRAM writer for exactly two bytes at caller destination DE.

units.name: InitializeEncounterProjectileCycle
units.summary: Set category 1A, position Y=A8/X=C8, animation 50 and presentation 5E. Enter substate one with a 16-tick phase timer and zero phase count.

units.name: UpdateEncounterProjectileCycle
units.summary: Consume hit flag 7, service the hit helper and increment field 42. The saved TH-probe result chooses a five- or eight-hit threshold. Defeat clears the adjacent actor area, requests sound A2 and enters the staged disappearance helper. Otherwise alternate idle/attack phases and scan the encoded actor slots before creating type-85 projectiles at the attack midpoint.

units.name: DrawEncounterDefeatStages
units.summary: Every 16 ticks clear the encounter animation and run the defeat-stage helper. For the first five phases read a six-byte VRAM-rectangle descriptor from fixed CPU 74C4 while bank 13 supplies the referenced source; perform the transfer under DI/EI. After five phases enter substate three.

units.name: CompleteEncounterStageClear
units.summary: Set the stage-clear session bit and tail-call the shared object clear routine.

units.name: InitializeSegmentedDirectionActor
units.summary: Select and clear the field-40 trail buffer with one zero plus a 32-byte LDIR. Initialize two adjacent type-86 companions, position this actor relative to C313/C316, select animation 54/category 1C and initialize the six-bit direction through the shared heading helper. Field 39 is cleared for the wrapping lifetime countdown.

units.name: UpdateSegmentedActorHeading
units.summary: Save direction field 43, service the shared heading update and compare the result. If direction did not change, reflect at Y outside 10..9F and X outside 10..DF, negating the corresponding velocity and transforming the six-bit angle. If the target angle changed, enter a 32-tick turning phase and choose its shortest wrapped direction.

units.name: TurnSegmentedActorTowardTarget
units.summary: During the 32-tick turn window reflect both current and saved direction at screen bounds. Every fourth tick step saved angle field 44 by one in the chosen wrapped direction. Use its low nibble and quadrant bits to load/swap/sign the four-byte vector at CPU 7484, storing the resulting Y/X velocity. Reaching the target restores straight motion.

units.name: WaitForSegmentedActorRemoval
units.summary: Count down field 36 and clear the object when it reaches zero.

units.name: UpdateSegmentedActorCoordinateTrail
units.summary: Move without acceleration and shift 30 saved trail bytes backward by two, then insert current Y/X. Field 39 counts down with normal byte wrap; expiry hides this actor, starts a 32-tick removal state and primes its two companions with staggered delays four/eight before stopping both velocities.

units.name: InitializeSegmentCompanion
units.summary: Choose animation 53 minus the companion index and enter substate one.

units.name: FollowSegmentParentTrail
units.summary: If a removal timer is active, decrement it and clear this companion at zero. Otherwise use the companion index to read the Y/X pair 14 or 28 bytes into the selected trail buffer and copy it to the companion position.

units.name: WaitForBonusThreatTimeout
units.summary: Count down the 16-bit 300-tick timer, then complete the bonus wave and mute the audio service before restoring bank 2.

units.name: SelectEncounterFacingRecoil
units.summary: Clear both animation timing bytes. The primary-X relation selects animation 61/67 and X-velocity high byte 02/FE; the caller supplies the low byte.

units.name: UpdateEncounterAttackAndHitRecovery
units.summary: Initialize a three-phase attack with a 16-tick timer, stopped X high byte and facing animation 66/6C. Each phase resets timing and decrements the animation. Only the final attack phase consumes hit bit 7: service the hit helper, increment hit count and enter a 16-tick facing recoil. Three hits start a 64-tick disappearance. A separate airborne recovery waits for contact, clears state bit 4 and restarts substate two. The terminal entry clears the object, installs type 88 and joins the encounter effect helper.

units.name: JoinEncounterHorizontalStop
units.summary: Join the existing stop-X block with the caller state intact.

units.name: StopEncounterHorizontalVelocity
units.summary: Clear both X-velocity bytes and return. The following entry dispatches the next encounter behavior.

units.name: UpdateOscillatingEncounterProjectile
units.summary: Run the shared motion helper and dispatch through CPU 6B3F. Initialize category 1C/animation 72 and a refresh-register-selected Y from four bytes at CPU 6B47. Face the primary actor with X high byte 03 or FD; two substates subtract/add 0040 from X velocity until the opposite high-byte bound is reached, then enter the terminal return substate.

units.name: UpdateLeapingEncounterWithChildren
units.summary: Clamp X and dispatch through CPU 6CC2. Initialize bank-8 graphics 9805, category 1A, animation 73 and a position opposite the primary actor. Wait 16 ticks, then jump with Y velocity FA80 and acceleration 30; horizontal speed is primary-X distance divided by 58 with its sign restored. Change animation near the apex, land and scan three slots for type-8B children with encoded delay values. Hit recovery interrupts the normal caller path, increments a three-hit threshold and chooses grounded/airborne recoil. Defeat waits for children to clear and a 64-tick delay before installing type 8C.

units.name: UpdateAuxiliaryLeapingActor
units.summary: Clamp X and remove immediately on hit bit 7. Initialize category 1C at Y=A8 with facing idle animation 7C/7F, then wait the supplied timer. Jump with Y velocity FA80, acceleration 30 and a distance/58 signed X velocity. Change animation at the apex, land, stop X and wait 128 ticks before repeating. This related actor has no independent hit-recovery chain.

units.name: UpdateDashingEncounter
units.summary: Initialize bank-8 graphics A4BE and position opposite the primary actor. A 32-tick idle chooses either a dash across the screen or a dash stopping within 16 pixels of the primary actor, with X high byte FC/04. At close range use facing animation 85/88 and pause 32 ticks. Hit recovery interrupts the caller and increments an eight-hit threshold. Defeat expands bank-8 graphics B669 to VRAM 0C00, runs three eight-tick animation stages and a 64-tick delay, then sets stage clear and removes the object.

units.name: EncounterStateReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the encounter state dispatch.

units.name: CheckAllSixteenEncounterFlags
units.summary: Scan all 16 bytes from C800 for bit 7. Return as soon as a clear flag is found; only when every flag is set change this object to type 8F.

units.name: AdvanceEncounterPanelIndex
units.summary: Increment panel index field 43, clear its phase counter and reload the one-tick phase divider.

units.name: UpdateEncounterPanelDamageAndCollapse
units.summary: Service a hit and count four hits before marking a panel complete. Earlier hits enter a four-frame damage restoration sequence; the fourth draws the terminal six-by-four tile rectangle, marks the corresponding C800 group cell and adjusts neighboring actor ranks in the same group. Collapse phases move graphics downward one tile every four ticks, erase exposed rows and preserve partially covered rows using the encoded panel rank. All rectangle transfers run under DI/EI with bank 13 selected for the source. On completion restore idle state, clear the hit flag and decrement the actor phase/rank counter. The exact visual identity of this multi-panel encounter remains uncertain; its flag-grid and VRAM mechanics are explicit.

units.name: DispatchEncounterSpawningCycle
units.summary: Clamp the encounter X position and dispatch through the CPU 6AB8 state table. Initialization expands bank-8 graphics from 8E45 to VRAM 06C0, selects category 1A and positions the encounter opposite the primary actor. Three 16-tick opening phases lead into movement/spawning. Alternate stopped and +/-0200 motion, scanning three actor slots and creating type 89 at the encounter X every eight ticks. Hits enter facing recoil and increment a three-hit threshold; defeat waits 64 ticks, then waits for the child slots to empty before replacing this actor with type 8A.

units.name: InterruptLeapingEncounterOnHit
units.summary: On hit bit 7, service the hit helper, clear the flag and increment field 42. Choose grounded substate five or airborne six, then POP HL discards this helper caller return so the normal state body is skipped. Select facing recoil velocity +/-0200 and animation 74/78. No inline bytes are consumed by this stack adjustment.

units.name: InterruptDashingEncounterOnHit
units.summary: Consume hit bit 7, service the hit helper and POP HL to skip the remaining caller state body. Increment hit count, select a 32-tick recovery state and use facing animation 83/86 with X-velocity high byte 02/FE.

units.name: ComputeEncounterPanelWriteAddress
units.summary: The first entry uses panel index minus two; the adjacent entry uses minus one. Mask to the low two bits and multiply by 384 bytes, add eight bytes from index bit 2 and choose write-address base 7930/7900 from bit 3. These include the VDP write flag and identify VRAM 3930/3900, not CPU ROM addresses. A following helper selects the related 78B0/7880 base plus the same eight-byte offset.

units.name: UpdateVerticalSpawningEncounter
units.summary: Consume hit flag 7 and clear the encounter after eight hits, setting stage clear through the shared effect helper. Otherwise move without acceleration and dispatch CPU 729A states. Wait for the horizontal display offset to become zero, initialize at Y=B0/X=E8, then alternate Y-velocity high bytes FF/01 between bounds 50/B0. At the lower bound scan six slots and create type 90 positioned 16 pixels above this actor.

units.name: UpdateBouncingEncounterProjectile
units.summary: Move through the shared guard and dispatch CPU 7323 states. Initialize sound A1, category 1C, animation 58, X velocity FD00 and a vertical acceleration byte of 40 or 60 according to initial height. Add acceleration until Y reaches B0, clamp Y there and negate its velocity. Continue acceleration until the vertical word reaches zero, then restart the falling state.

units.name: MoveAndCullObjectWithCallerAbort
units.summary: Move without acceleration and test screen Y<D0 and X within 08..F7. Out-of-range motion joins the stack-aborting clear entry below, preventing the caller from continuing on a zeroed object.

units.name: DivideUnsignedHLByE
units.summary: Initialize the 17-step restoring division loop for unsigned HL divided by E. The shift/subtract process builds the quotient in HL and the partial remainder in A. No zero-divisor guard is supplied; callers must establish E.

units.name: UpdateFinalEncounterLandingAndDefeatStates
units.summary: Apply vertical contact motion. Landings at or below A0 decrement the phase count and either repeat the existing attack or begin defeat: stop the primary object, run the 30-tick animation transitions and request sounds A0/A2. The terminal 30-tick state sets stage clear, awards through the shared helper and removes the encounter. An alternate direct-Y integration clamps the actor at A0 and selects substate eight. These are encounter mechanics, not proof of a credits route.

units.name: InterruptFinalEncounterWithRecoil
units.summary: Service the hit helper, set motion flags A0, X velocity 0080, Y velocity FD00 and acceleration 20, then select substate two. POP AF discards the helper caller return before returning, so the interrupted state body is skipped.

units.name: BeginFinalEncounterFortyTickPause
units.summary: Stop the encounter through its common helper, select substate three and load a 40-tick timer.

units.name: StopFinalEncounterHorizontalMotion
units.summary: Set motion flags 20, clear X velocity and return.

units.name: SetFinalEncounterSlowRightMotion
units.summary: Set X velocity 0080 (half a pixel per frame in 8.8 units).

units.name: AdvanceBackgroundStripAnimation
units.summary: Only continue on a zero timer result. Reload four ticks, advance through two eight-byte tile blocks at CPU 7851 and draw a two-by-two rectangle at the saved VRAM position C6B6. At terminal phase two clear BackgroundStripFlags bit 0.

units.name: BeginEncounterThreeCycleTransition
units.summary: Load phase count three and a 16-tick secondary timer, select substate two and join the existing encounter transition at CPU 7A85.

units.name: FinishEncounterDistanceBranch
units.summary: Preserve the preceding carry test: no carry rejoins CPU 78FB; carry selects substate one and continues below.

units.name: EncounterMotionReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the encounter motion flow.

units.name: FinishEncounterXVelocityStore
units.summary: Store the caller-prepared H into the X-velocity high byte and return; the low byte was handled by the preceding fragment.

units.name: JoinEncounterHorizontalDecision
units.summary: Tail-call the existing horizontal-state decision at CPU 7991.

units.name: SpawnEncounterOffsetChild
units.summary: Allocate a free child slot and return on failure. Convert the parent position to the encoded screen offsets, storing child X=parent X+50 and Y=parent Y-48 modulo one byte with both extensions zero. Create type 6E, mark scroll flag 6 and enter parent substate two with a 16-tick secondary timer.

units.name: ResetEncounterSubstateOnZero
units.summary: On a zero result from the preceding timer, clear the encounter substate; nonzero returns without changing it.

units.name: FinishEncounterTimedChildCleanup
units.summary: After field-45 countdown expires, change this actor to type 93, clear the primary object and stop both velocities. Scan three adjacent child slots; nonzero children whose masked state is not 83 become type 66 and receive the shared effect call with C=4. Restore IX and finish with the parent effect C=6.

units.name: EncounterAllocationReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return preceding the three-slot allocator.

units.name: RaiseEncounterStripUntilStageClear
units.summary: Service the existing encounter helper, request vertical scroll delta FF80 and update both camera-relative motion and background strip. When extended Y is one and screen Y reaches 58, clear strip flags and set the stage-clear session bit.

units.name: UpdateEncounterEffectAnimation
units.summary: Initialize category 19, animation 56 and sound A3 once. Thereafter move with the camera and remove when animation index returns to zero.

units.name: ComputePreviousEncounterPanelWriteAddress
units.summary: Use panel index minus one before the shared six-row-pitch address calculation.

units.name: AbortObjectCallerAndClearRecord
units.summary: POP HL discards the immediate caller return before falling through to the 48-byte record clear. This stack-sensitive entry is distinct from the ordinary clear entry one byte later.

units.name: ClearObjectRecord48
units.summary: Zero the current IX record: seed one zero byte and LDIR the remaining 47 bytes. Return normally unless entered through the preceding caller-abort byte.

units.name: AimObjectHeadingAtPrimaryOffset
units.summary: Measure signed X distance and Y distance to primary Y minus 20, replacing zero magnitudes with one before ratio division. Compare axis magnitudes, quantize their ratio, select/swap the encoded velocity pair and restore both signs. The quadrant table supplies the six-bit direction in field 43. This avoids zero division for coincident axes and preserves the specific 32-pixel vertical aiming offset.

units.name: QuantizeUnsignedAxisRatio
units.summary: Perform eight shift/subtract steps using E as divisor, then return the complemented rotated quotient byte. The heading consumer masks its high nibble to choose a finite velocity/angle entry.

units.name: AllocateEncounterChildSlot
units.summary: Scan three 48-byte slots from C340. A zero type returns IY with carry set; exhaustion returns A=0 and carry clear. The caller installs the child type.

units.name: PositionEncounterTwoActorBackgroundStrip
units.summary: Require both C460/C490 slots free. Transform the parent Y/X into a bounded tile-row and horizontal position, rejecting out-of-range values. Combine the row, hardware horizontal scroll and eight-pixel-aligned X into VRAM 3880-based tile coordinates at C6B6. Position type-6B/6C actors, mark the background-strip request and initialize its animation timer. All VRAM calculations use row pitch 64 bytes and two-byte tile cells.

units.name: AwardThroughBankTwoHelper
units.summary: Explicitly map bank 2, copy C to request A and tail-call CPU B28B. This helper establishes the bank for that transfer.

units.name: RequestEncounterHitSound
units.summary: Request sound B1 and return.

units.name: SpawnEncounterOffsetEffectCycle
units.summary: Every four timer ticks scan three actor slots after the primary object. Use a modulo-eight selector to read a two-byte Y/X offset from CPU 7BA5, apply it to the encounter position with the encoded extension carries and create type 94. EncounterEffectOffsetPairs supplies all eight pairs.

units.name: RotateBonusShotCollisionSlot
units.summary: Advance C649 modulo four and select IX from C460/C490/C4C0/C4F0. Check only one shot slot per call, spreading the collision scan across frames. Actual execution was observed after the documented artificial bonus transition; unvisited alternatives retain their Static classification.

units.name: TestBonusShotAgainstEightTargets
units.summary: Skip presentation zero, then form the selected shot bounds from bank-2 CPU B469. Scan exactly eight RAM-slot pointers at B161 using the established B029 target-hitbox helper and B64E records. A nonzero collision result sets target IY state bit 7 and returns; no mapper write occurs in this routine/helper contract.

units.name: AdvanceSharedAudioChannelRecord
units.summary: Advance IX by the independent 32-byte audio record stride, restore the loop count and continue the surrounding channel traversal. Return after its encoded count is exhausted.

units.name: RepeatSharedAudioChannelTraversal
units.summary: Rejoin the preceding audio-record loop without altering the selected record layout.

units.name: SuppressSharedPsgNoiseChannel
units.summary: In PSG mode set suppression bit 2 in the DECE channel record. FM mode returns without changing that record.

units.name: AudioArbitrationReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the shared-channel arbitration service.

units.name: AbortTwoAudioCallersAndStop
units.summary: Discard two return addresses, then jump to bank-6 CPU 8013. This deliberate stack unwind terminates the nested audio path; do not treat the discarded words as inline parameters.

units.name: AudioFadeReturnStub
units.summary: Immediate return in the fade service.

units.name: FinishFmFadeRegisterLoop
